D: Deadpool drags a reluctant Wolverine into a mission to save his world.
P: Serve the snacks when Deadpool finds Dogpool in the Void.
S: Deadpool's favourite food, made for two
Pulled pork with chipotle and cheddar rolled in tortillas, fried at 180C until crisp, with guacamole and sour cream.
Deadpool's favourite thing in any universe
Mini fried burritos filled with spiced beef, beans and cheese, with sour cream and salsa.
the dusty wasteland of the Void
Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C until crisp, tossed straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt.
M: Wade's birthday party with his friends
Barbecue pork ribs slow cooked at 150C for 3 hours, glazed and charred, with corn and slaw.
the resistance hideout out in the Void
Beef and kidney bean chilli simmered with cumin and tomato, served with cheddar and corn chips.
W: Deadpool's red suit next to Wolverine's yellow one
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, half spooned over with raspberry sauce and half with mango purée, whipped cream piled on top.
K: Whisky poured over one large ice cube, or ginger ale with lime for the non-drinkers.

s.note: Deadpool's favourite thing in any universe
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 tbsp taco seasoning, add 400g refried beans and cool. Fill 8 small tortillas with the mix and 120g grated cheese, roll tightly and fry seam down at 180C until golden. Halve and serve with 200g sour cream and 300g salsa.

s.note: the dusty wasteland of the Void
s.how: Slice 800g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly and fry at 170C in batches until crisp. Toss straight away with smoked paprika, garlic powder and sea salt. Serve in a big bowl, dusty as a wasteland.

m.note: the resistance hideout out in the Void
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Add 2 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, a 400g can crushed tomatoes and a 400g can drained kidney beans. Simmer for 40 minutes, then serve with grated cheddar and corn chips.

w.note: Deadpool's red suit next to Wolverine's yellow one
w.how: Blend 200g raspberries with a spoon of sugar and strain. Blend a mango until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, spoon raspberry sauce down one side and mango down the other, then pile whipped cream on top.

d.how: Set one big ice cube in each short glass. Pour 45ml whisky over it for those drinking. For everyone else, pour ginger ale over ice with a squeeze of fresh lime. Drink with a scowl.
